groups.note: County, municipal, school, and special-district names are keyed from official Carbon clerk general summaries (2018, 2020, 2022, 2024, and 2026) and official 2022 certified write-ins. The official 2020 DocumentCenter slug still says unofficial; the PDF header is OFFICIAL RESULTS. Official 2014 and 2016 Carbon clerk canvasses are archived but were not fully keyed here, so January 2015–2018 local rows are largely Not yet collected rather than invented. Multi-county legislative seats use official SOS district-wide Total rows, with the official Carbon share noted. Official Carbon election-results pages state that Sweetwater results must be added for School District #1 and LSR Conservation; official Sweetwater clerk general totals are included and cited. The Rawlins mayor is chosen by the city council (official Rawlins Municipal Code 2.04.030); the current mayor is from the official City of Rawlins council page, and the January 2027 mayor is not invented. Official mid-term vacancies are not invented. Official 2024 hospital-board contests are omitted because the official 2024 special hospital district formation failed.
